about_the_game:
🛠️ BoB - Battle of Bots

Pilot BOB - Humanity's last hope in a postapocalyptic scrapyard showdown against endless mechanical mayhem!

Welcome to BoB - Battle of Bots, an adrenaline-fueled, action-packed survival game where your reflexes, strategy, and upgrades are the only things standing between humanity and the rise of rogue machines.

Step into the pilot seat as Helena, controlling BOB, a battle-hardened Mecha built from scavenged parts. Together, you’ll fight to protect the ancient city of Trier from endless waves of robotic enemies. Level up, unlock powerful abilities, and see how long you can survive in this thrilling bot-bashing arena.

🧠 The Story

In the wreckage of Trier’s once-thriving industrial sector, an army of corrupted bots rises. Their goal? Total annihilation. But BOB — and his fearless pilot Helena won’t go down without a fight. As the city’s last line of defense, you must stand strong, upgrade fast, and keep moving or risk being overwhelmed and turned to smoking scrap!

⚔️ Key Features

  • 🔁 Endless Waves of Enemies

Face a relentless onslaught of varied enemy bots in a fast-paced, wave-based survival mode. Each wave gets harder but more enemies also mean more XP — How long can you last?

  • 🚀 Endless Upgrades

Gain XP with every bot you destroy. Choose between new abilities, weapons or passive skill upgrades to create your own unstoppable build and fight style. Every run is different! 

  • 💥 Unlock Powerful Abilities

Whether it’s devastating AoE attacks or life-saving defensive skills, build a loadout that suits your style and turns the battlefield in your favor.

  • ⚙️ Upgrade Your Arsenal

Power up your favorite abilities to insane levels. Maximize damage, reduce cooldowns, or add unique effects like doubling projectiles or bouncing bullets that give you the edge you need.

🛠️ Coming Soon: Mech Customization

Personalize BOB’s look and loadout! New visual styles, weapons, and ability slots will let you create the ultimate bot-battling machine. (Coming in a future update!)

🔥 Are You Ready to Face the Challenge?

Only the strongest will survive. Will you rise through the chaos and become the ultimate bot-slaying legend?

Jump into the fight. Level. Upgrade. Survive.

Welcome to the Battle of Bots.

🕹️ Add BoB to your Wishlist now and join the resistance!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows Vista and above (64 bits)
  • Processor: Intel, AMD 2 cores CPU at 2Ghz
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon™ HD 7730, NVIDIA GeForce® GT 640
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or higher
  • Processor: Intel Core i7- 8 Gen / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X 6 cores 3.7 GHz
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Welcome to BOB, an adrenaline-pumping, action-packed game where your skills are the only thing standing between humanity and endless waves of robotic enemies! Your mission is simple: Survive for as long as you can, obliterating waves of enemies and leveling up to unlock new abilities and weapons.
